stories.headline: Microsoft unveils AI Transparency Initiative
stories.summary: Microsoft launched a cross-industry effort with 40+ partners to improve visibility, verification, and governance for AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: It could shape enterprise standards for trusted AI deployment across vendors.

stories.headline: Google Australia launches AI skilling hub
stories.summary: Google Australia opened a hub with more than 1,000 free and low-cost courses in AI, cloud, and digital skills.
stories.why_it_matters: It broadens access to AI training for workers and educators.
